scenario: [LEXP.9.6.1] counts POSITIVE patterns, so a rule with one positive pattern and one `no` pattern has no join to retain and keeps its `cached()` read. PATH PINNED: `dsc.validate`'s `lexp_9_6_1_nonfact_where`, whose `positive_count` leaves out a `no` pattern. A version counting patterns rather than positive patterns would refuse this program, and no other vector here would notice.
rules_ds:
schema Reading scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    state: Float mutable

schema Ack scope ttl 5_min:
    entity_id: String
    ts: Time

rule gated:
    Reading r where cached("threshold") == r.state
    no Ack within 5_min
->
    log warning "gated"
